article.headline: Brooklyn takes on Cleveland for conference showdown
article.title: Brooklyn takes on Cleveland for conference showdown
article.linkText: Brooklyn takes on Cleveland for conference showdown
article.story: Brooklyn Nets vs. Cleveland Cavaliers Cleveland; Saturday, 7:30 p.m. EDT BOTTOM LINE: Brooklyn takes on Cleveland in Eastern Conference action Saturday. Cleveland went 52-30 overall and 33-19 in Eastern Conference action a season ago. The Cavaliers averaged 18.4 points off of turnovers, 15.1 second-chance points and 33.4 bench points last season. Brooklyn finished 20-62 overall and 14-37 in Eastern Conference action during the 2025-26 season. The Nets averaged 8.0 steals, 4.3 blocks and 15.0 turnovers per game last season. INJURIES: Cavaliers: Nae'Qwan Tomlin: out (back), Khalifa Diop: day to day (knee). Nets: Tyler Bilodeau: day to day (shoulder). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
